"""Structural fuzz: mutate valid documents, require exit 0 + valid JSON."""
import copy, json, random, subprocess, sys, time

PROJ = '/workspace/project'

BASE = {
  "seed": "s0.seed_-",
  "definitions": [["a", "b'xy'"], ["b", "a * 2"], ["c", "b[1:3]"], ["d", "{{ }}".replace('{{ }}','"uni\\u00e9" + c')]],
  "timeout_ms": 7,
  "cases": [
    {"name": "alpha", "frames": [
        {"Type": "headers", "headers_kv": {":method": "GET", ":path": "/x", "host": "H.Example"}, "End_Stream": False},
        {"Type": "sleep", "Time_to_Stop": 2},
        {"Type": "data", "data_to_transfered": "{{ b'p' * 4 }}", "End_Stream": False},
        {"Type": "datagram", "data_to_transfered": "dg<<random_string>>", "End_Stream": True},
        {"Type": "headers", "data_to_transfered": [["x", "y"]], "End_Stream": True}],
     "expect": {"method": "GET", "target": "/x", "host": "h.example"}},
    {"name": "beta", "frames": [], "expect": {"method": "POST", "target": "/y", "host": "other"}},
  ],
  "events": [
    {"at": 1, "kind": "headers", "stream": 0, "fields": [[":status", "200"]], "end": False},
    {"at": 3, "kind": "data", "stream": 0, "data": "body<<random_string>>", "end": True},
    {"at": 4, "kind": "data", "stream": 4, "data": "{{ b'q' * 2 }}", "end": False},
    {"at": 9, "kind": "close"}],
  "channels": [
    {"name": "cap1", "parts": [
        {"case": "alpha", "data": "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: H.Example\r\nContent-Length: 4\r\n\r\nabcd"},
        {"case": None, "data": "POST /y HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n2\r\nab\r\n0\r\nT: v\r\n\r\n"},
        {"case": "beta", "data": ""}]},
    {"name": "cap2", "parts": [{"case": "alpha", "data": "{{ b'BROKEN / HTTP/1.1' }}"}]},
  ]}

MUTATIONS = [
    lambda d, r: d.__setitem__('seed', r.choice(['', 'x' * 64, 'x' * 65, 'a b', 'é', 5, None])),
    lambda d, r: d.__setitem__('timeout_ms', r.choice([0, 1, 10**9, 10**9 + 1, -1, 1.5, True, '5'])),
    lambda d, r: d.__setitem__('definitions', r.choice([[], [["a", "b'x'"]], [["a", "b'x'"], ["a", "b'y'"]],
                                                        [["a", "1"]], [["a", "b'x'["]], [["1a", "b'x'"]],
                                                        [["a", "b'x' * " + str(2**63)]], [["a", "b'x'" + " + b'y'" * 300]],
                                                        [["a", "b'x'[0:2][0:2]" + "[0:2]" * 130]], "x"])),
    lambda d, r: d['cases'].__setitem__(r.randrange(len(d['cases'])),
                                        r.choice([{}, {"name": "x", "frames": [], "expect": {"method": "GET", "target": "/", "host": "h"}},
                                                  {"name": "alpha", "frames": [], "expect": {"method": "GET", "target": "/", "host": "h"}},
                                                  {"name": "g%d" % r.randrange(50), "frames": [{"Type": "sleep", "Time_to_Stop": 2**63}],
                                                   "expect": {"method": "GET", "target": "/", "host": "h"}},
                                                  {"name": "g%d" % r.randrange(50), "frames": [{"Type": "headers", "data_to_transfered": [["a", "b"]] * 129}],
                                                   "expect": {"method": "GET", "target": "/", "host": "h"}},
                                                  {"name": "g%d" % r.randrange(50), "frames": [{"Type": "data", "data_to_transfered": "{{ nope }}"}],
                                                   "expect": {"method": "GET", "target": "/", "host": "h"}},
                                                  5])),
    lambda d, r: d['cases'][r.randrange(len(d['cases']))].__setitem__('frames', r.choice([
        [], [{"Type": "sleep", "Time_to_Stop": -1}], [{"Type": "sleep", "Time_to_Stop": 1, "End_Stream": False}],
        [{"Type": "headers", "headers_kv": {}, "data_to_transfered": []}], [{"Type": "headers", "headers_kv": {}}],
        [{"Type": "headers", "data_to_transfered": [["a"]]}], [{"Type": "headers", "data_to_transfered": [["a", 1]]}],
        [{"Type": "headers", "data_to_transfered": [["a", "b"]], "End_Stream": "true"}],
        [{"Type": "data", "data_to_transfered": "x" * 65537}], [{"Type": "data", "data_to_transfered": "{{ b'x' * 2**63 }}"}],
        [{"Type": "datagram", "data_to_transfered": "<<random_string>"}], [{"Type": "unknown"}], [{"type": "data"}],
        [{"Type": "data", "data_to_transfered": "{{ b'x' }}", "Extra": 1}]])),
    lambda d, r: d['cases'][r.randrange(len(d['cases']))].__setitem__('expect', r.choice([
        {"method": "", "target": "/", "host": "h"}, {"method": "GE T", "target": "/", "host": "h"},
        {"method": "GET", "target": "/ x", "host": "h"}, {"method": "GET", "target": "/", "host": "h" * 8193},
        {"method": "GET", "target": "/é", "host": "h"}, {"method": "G:T", "target": "/", "host": "h"},
        {"method": "GET", "target": "/"}, {"method": "GET", "target": "/", "host": "h", "z": 1}, 5])),
    lambda d, r: d.__setitem__('events', r.choice([
        [], [{"at": 0, "kind": "close", "stream": 0}], [{"at": -1, "kind": "close"}],
        [{"at": 0, "kind": "data", "stream": 0, "data": "x"}],
        [{"at": 0, "kind": "data", "stream": 2**32, "data": "x", "end": True}],
        [{"at": 0, "kind": "headers", "stream": 0, "fields": [["a", "b"]] * 129, "end": True}],
        [{"at": 0, "kind": "headers", "stream": 0, "fields": [["a"]], "end": True}],
        [{"at": 0, "kind": "weird"}], [{"at": 2**63, "kind": "close"}], [{"at": 0, "kind": "close"}, {"at": 0, "kind": "close"}]])),
    lambda d, r: d.__setitem__('channels', r.choice([
        [], [{"name": "cap1", "parts": []}], [{"name": "bad name", "parts": []}],
        [{"name": "x", "parts": [{"case": "nosuch", "data": ""}]}],
        [{"name": "x", "parts": [{"case": None, "data": 5}]}],
        [{"name": "x", "parts": [{"case": None, "data": "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n"}]},
         {"name": "x", "parts": [{"case": None, "data": "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"}]}],
        [{"name": "x", "parts": [{"case": None, "data": "{{ b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nContent-Length: 5\\r\\n\\r\\nab' }}"}]}],
        [{"name": "x", "parts": [{"case": None, "data": "{{ b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\n' }}"}]}]])),
    lambda d, r: d.__setitem__(r.choice(list(d) + ['extra']), r.choice([None, 5, 'x', [], {}])),
    lambda d, r: d.pop(r.choice(list(d))),
]


def main(n=1500):
    bad = 0
    for seed in range(n):
        rnd = random.Random(seed)
        d = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
        for _ in range(rnd.randrange(1, 4)):
            try:
                rnd.choice(MUTATIONS)(d, rnd)
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            payload = json.dumps(d)
        except Exception:
            continue
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'main.py'], cwd=PROJ,
                           input=payload.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                           stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
        ok = True
        if p.returncode != 0:
            ok = False
        else:
            try:
                out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
                if not isinstance(out, dict):
                    ok = False
                elif 'error' in out:
                    if out != {'error': 'input'}:
                        ok = False
                elif set(out) != {'cases', 'channels'}:
                    ok = False
            except Exception:
                ok = False
        if not ok:
            bad += 1
            print('BAD seed', seed, 'rc', p.returncode, p.stdout[:200], p.stderr[-600:])
            print('   input', payload[:600])
            if bad > 4:
                break
    print('cli fuzz done, bad =', bad)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1500)
